newsitem.title: USA: US Plains feedlot cattle priced at $68 - trade.
newsitem.headline: US Plains feedlot cattle priced at $68 - trade.

text.p: U.S. feedlot cattle were priced $1.00 higher at $68.00 per cwt, but feedlot managers doubt there will be many sales Friday.
"We are proud of what we have left and I don't think they (packers) can buy any for less than $68.00," said a Kansas feedlot manager.
Kansas feedlot sources said many of the cattle sold early this week have been shipped, indicating meat packers have low inventories of cattle.

Feedlot managers' hopes for higher cattle prices have been bolstered by active beef sales this week and a decreased supply of market-ready cattle. One manager said all that remains on his showlist were short-day or lower-grading cattle, and meat packers were inquiring Thursday about buying them at steady prices.
Cold, damp conditions spread through the Plains feedlot areas Thursday, but so far the weather had not affected cattle performance, feedlot sources said.
